rationale: dst_payload samples the changing asynchronous src_payload bus on every dst_clk edge with no qualification. The consumer uses dst_payload as a transaction when v2 is high, but the capture can be metastable or incoherent across bits at that time. The synchronised valid does not gate the capture.
caveats: CDC-029(a) is the precise predicate: an asynchronous input-delay contract with precise unsynchronised captures gives ERROR Established.

CDC-016 (unguarded payload despite a synchronised control in the same scope) and CDC-004 describe the same defect if their crossing-group predicates include delay-bound primary inputs. If they do not, CDC-029 alone carries the case.
CDC-039 is an obligation and cannot earn credit.

Raw rst_n asynchronously resets every register with no local release synchroniser and no SDC reset exception; RDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved), RDC-002 (WARNING Unresolved) and RDC-013 (physical obligation) are expected if RDC rules run. The contract states only asynchronous assertion, so this is a whole-IP premise gap, not a defect of the labelled crossing.
